products.title: Mykonos - On The Rocks Extrait de Parfum 100ml
products.body_html:
Mykonos - On The Rocks Extrait de Parfum 100ml

"I want something sweet, boozy, aromatic, and bold... but make it On The Rocks."

Like a perfectly crafted cocktail, On The Rocks stirs unexpected contrasts into an intoxicating blend. The first spritz is a crisp splash of bergamot and apple, fresh and invigorating, before the rich depth of myrrh swirls in—smooth, warm, and seductively bold, like an amber liquor poured slow.

As the scent settles, the smoky elegance of guaiacwood and the floral sensuality of orange flower unfold, while a hint of praline lingers like the lingering sweetness of an irresistible sip. Finally, vanilla and ambroxan melt into the skin, wrapping you in a trail that’s both sultry and dangerously smooth—the scent of a night you’ll never forget.

Crisp yet deep. Smooth yet daring. Indulgent yet refined.
This is your dream drink, bottled. One spritz, and you’re hooked.
